app_fee.value: No application fee for PhD applicants is stated on the official doctoral pages checked; the only fee on the PhD how-to-apply page is a small fee for a Scholaro GPA report.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee waiver or international fee waiver for PhD applicants is stated on the official pages checked.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement is stated on the official doctoral pages checked.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT total 90 with 21 in Writing for PhD applicants, with other sub-scores at the mid-point of high-intermediate level.
toefl_min.quote: PhD only: Total score of 90 with a 21 in Writing

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with no band below 6.0 for postgraduate study, which includes the PhD.
ielts_min.quote: Overall score of 6.5 with no band lower than 6.0

english_waiver.value: Indian applicants may meet the English requirement only if the whole undergraduate degree was taught in English at a listed IIT or NIT, completed within two years of application, with English medium confirmed; other Indian applicants need a test.
english_waiver.quote: Students who have studied at one of the institutions in India listed below may satisfy the English language requirements, if the following criteria are met

also.quote: Successful completion of an entire undergraduate degree at one of the institutions listed below
The study must have been undertaken no more than two years prior to the point of application

notes: Official PhD English table (standard postgraduate page) is used for IELTS and TOEFL; the domestic English page was not used. No application fee is stated for doctoral applicants. PhD application rounds are 1 March, 1 July and 1 November with no year on the official pages, so no deadline is recorded as 2027. International PhD tuition is NZ$11,150 per 120 points (estimated for 2027), which is tuition, not an application fee.
